description: One LFO with four shapes available at once, plus a pulse whose width you set

params.text: Sets the rate, 1Hz to 32Hz with the switch on FAST and 0.033Hz to 1.07Hz with it on SLOW
Shifts every output along the cycle, a full cycle across the knob's travel
Sets how much of each cycle the pulse output spends high
Divides the rate by 30, taking the LFO from the FAST range into the SLOW one

inputs.text: A rising edge sends the cycle back to the start, which puts every output at the point set by PHASE
Adds to the PW knob, 5V covering the whole range, with no limit on the total
Shifts the rate by one octave per volt, multiplying whatever the RATE knob is set to
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the phase comes from the PHASE knob alone

outputs.text: A sawtooth falling from 8V to -8V across each cycle
A pulse sitting at 8V for the part of the cycle set by PW and -8V for the rest
A sawtooth rising from -8V to 8V across each cycle

notes: All four outputs run from the same cycle at the same rate, separated only by shape.

inputs.0: high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
